sources: Bhagat, Burke, Diuk, Filiz & Edunov (2016), Three and a half degrees of separation, Facebook Research – about 1.59 billion active users; each person is connected to every other person by an average of 3.57 people in between (USA: 3.46; 2011: 3.74).
